text: Kickoff: target launch 2026-10-15, pending the security review.
PM sync (Priya Shah): the security review found two blockers, so the Orion launch moved to 2026-11-03.
Marketing: announce the launch date only after the PM confirms it in writing. Confirmed by Priya on 2026-09-23.
The weekly newsletter goes out on Thursdays. Draft deadline is Wednesday noon.
